name: openworkgraph-local
description: Connect Claude Desktop to the compact local OpenWorkGraph context surface.
long_description: Uses the OpenWorkGraph installation already running on this computer. New connections expose a compact read-oriented tool surface while the legacy 24-tool stdio entrypoint remains available for existing configurations. Workflow evidence remains in the local OpenWorkGraph store until Claude requests it through MCP. AI access can be turned off instantly from the OpenWorkGraph dashboard.

tools.name: get_current_work_context
tools.description: Read bounded current evidence, task hints and semantic activity.

tools.name: search_work
tools.description: Search prior work through evidence or semantic layers.

tools.name: get_workflow_trace
tools.description: Read canonical paginated workflow evidence, optionally for one session.

tools.name: get_work_profile
tools.description: Read derived workflow signals without productivity scoring.

tools.name: find_repeated_workflows
tools.description: Find repeated-work candidates and exact procedural-memory family keys for follow-up.

tools.name: get_task_context
tools.description: Read a bounded task-context bundle with provenance and authority separation.

tools.name: how_did_similar_runs_go
tools.description: Read descriptive outcomes, failure points, approval hotspots and observed next steps from a selected prior-run family.

tools.name: get_agent_runs
tools.description: List privacy-safe agent runs or inspect one structural trace by execution ID.
